lesson: always segment by regime before believing a time-series correlation

what: fleet fingerprint does not lead hashrate
why: deployment shows up in hashrate and nonce pattern simultaneously; epoch granularity too coarse to see ramp
new_hypotheses: H011: daily-resolution fingerprint ramp vs daily hashrate (needs finer bins, ~144 blocks/day -> noisy)

what: price momentum adds nothing to difficulty forecast
why: hashrate supply response to price operates over months (ASIC lead times); 2-week epoch horizon too short; outliers dominate linear corr
lesson: epoch-horizon hashrate change is mostly supply-side, not price-side
new_hypotheses: H012: hashprice (price*reward/difficulty) below production-cost threshold -> hashrate DROP next epoch (nonlinear, needs cost curve data)

what: orphan rate trend and spread association
lesson: multi-source arrival data must be stratified by source type before any trend claim

why: observer composition dominates every dispersion metric
lesson: propagation trend claims need a fixed observer panel

what: prev-block propagation -> orphan risk (OR 15, AUC .78 on temporal holdout)
why: target (competing block *observed*) and feature (slowest observer) share the same node set; a node in a transient partition is both late and the one that sees the other branch
lesson: temporal holdout is not independent validation when feature and label come from the same observers. Independent-panel replication is mandatory for any observer-derived signal.
new_hypotheses: H018d: network-wide orphan risk needs a race label independent of the feature panel (e.g. stale blocks from a node set disjoint from the propagation panel)
